text:
nora: Heads-up  want to run a compact pricing-page experiment next week focused on two things: clarity of tier naming for infra buyers and making the interactive cost estimator feed qualified leads into sales. 10-14 day run.

sam: Love it. What's the minimal change set?

nora: Minimal: 1) update tier names to "Developer / Production / Reserved" (signal dev vs committed). 2) beneath each tier add 2 short bullets: SLA, data isolation. 3) replace the bulky calculator with a lightweight estimator and a gated 'Estimate private pricing' flow that creates a tagged lead.

priya: Can we split-test naming vs naming+calculator? I want to know if the calculator itself drives more MQLs.

james: Agree on A/B. Variant A = names+bullets only. Variant B = names+bullets + estimator. Measure: calc_open, calc_submit, private_cta_click, mql_submit.

nora: Estimator inputs for eng (simple JSON sample):
```
{
  "monthly_requests": 100000,
  "avg_tokens": 350,
  "cache_pct": 0.4,
  "private": false
}
```
Outputs should be: est_monthly_tokens, est_monthly_cost_usd, recommended_tier (rule: if tokens>45M and cache<0.5 -> Production/Reserved). If private=true show CTA with small form.

priya: Also add a small disclaimer: "Estimates are approximate; contact sales for exact pricing." Legal asked for this previously.

james: Routing: any form submitted from the estimator should be tagged "pricing-experiment-3" and queued to inbound-sales. If est_monthly_cost_usd > 40000 tag as high_value and ping sales channel.

ops-bot: Reminder: staged changes must be in staging by Wed 09:00 PT for legal & privacy review.

sam: I'll set up the Optimizely experiment and wire events. I'll also create a dashboard with conversion funnels: page_view -> calc_open -> calc_submit -> mql_submit.

nora: Who owns the FAQ tweak? We should add one FAQ: "Which option is best for regulated data?" short answer pointing to Private/Reserved + link. Priya can draft it.

priya: I can write the FAQ. Will keep it one sentence and add link to compliance page. Drop it here for quick review.

james: Dev notes for widget: localize numbers, round to nearest 10, show accuracy band +/-10%. Keep the UI minimal so we don't impact load. PR to eng by EOD today.

sam: Also add analytics event faq_view so we can see if the new FAQ reduces support contacts.

nora: Final checklist: PR for estimator -> eng, Optimizely config -> sam, FAQ draft -> priya, routing rules -> james. Stage Wed AM, launch Thu morning PT. Quick sync one week after launch to review early metrics.

ops-bot: Action items recorded. Legal & privacy notified for review.
